summary: Frontend-only testing of the rewritten Simpsons predictions timeline page. All critical flows pass: hero elements render, 24 prediction cards grouped under 13 year bubbles ascending 1992→2021, filter chips show correct counts (all 24, tech 5, politics 4, science 3, sports 3, culture 6, business 3) and filter correctly, hero CTA scrolls to #timeline, footer back-to-top returns to top, deep links /#trump and /#higgs scroll the matching card into view and reset filter to all, old routes (/ep/abc123, /u/paulg, etc.) render the same timeline page, mobile 390x844 has zero horizontal overflow, no console errors, custom fonts and art assets load.
critical_code_review_comments: Timeline.jsx groups by p.event via Map keyed on event year, which works because PREDICTIONS is pre-sorted by event ascending; if sort order ever changes, groups may be fragmented. Consider sorting the grouped entries explicitly as a safety net.
Footer back-to-top uses href=#top which works, but on routes with a hash (after a deep link) clicking it leaves the previous hash in the URL only replaced by #top — acceptable but worth noting.
Hero donut image has aria-hidden on an empty alt img — fine for a11y, no action needed.
No test-id on individual year group list items beyond year-{YYYY} bubble; sufficient for current spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a single static page served from TimelinePage.jsx under a catch-all route. All interactive bits have data-testid. Counts verified: tech 5, politics 4, science 3, sports 3, culture 6, business 3 = 24. Year bubbles present for every distinct came-true year.
